extracted_data.html:
Description

Engineered to meet the needs of the animal research laboratory, the Purair® CAGEX is designed to protect the user and the environment from animal dander or bedding material particulates generated on the work surface. The CAGEX incorporates carbon filters to absorb odor while optional HEPA filtration contains harmful particulates generated during cage changing and waste disposal operations.
